current: The prohibition does not hold. qip-fastbrain's composition root prints a multi-line cycle report to stdout on every cycle: main.rs:346-359 passes node::run a callback that does `println!("{}", outcome.report.summarise())` (CycleReport::summarise, qip-kernel/src/cycle.rs:159, one line per stage plus one per problem) and then one `println!` per rejected feed record (`for rejection in &outcome.rejections`). node::run (qip-fastbrain/src/node.rs:173-243) calls that callback once per cycle. The cycle runs every QIP_FASTBRAIN_CYCLE_INTERVAL_MS, default 100 ms (config.rs:30), and on a tape feed once per knowable tick instant (feed.rs:422-429, `Self::Tape(adapter) => adapter.advance()`). qip-fastbrain is a Cloud Run service pinned to one always-on instance (infrastructure/terraform/catalogue.tf:390-414, min_instances = max_instances = 1). Cloud Run ingests container stdout into Cloud Logging, and no logging exclusion or sink exists in infrastructure/terraform (grep for google_logging_project_exclusion/_sink -> 0). So a deployed fast brain writes about ten per-decision-cycle records a second into general-purpose log ingestion, and under tape replay the volume scales with tick count. qip-deepbrain prints the same per-cycle summary (main.rs:614-615), at its slower learning cadence. qip-edge-node writes one stderr line per requote and per reconciliation break inside the pass loop (main.rs:906,909). It is not deployed. What does hold: qip_observability::Logger is never called from qip-kernel's platform.rs (`grep -c 'logger\.' platform.rs` -> 0, against 127 `metrics.` sites), and qip_events::EventLog (log.rs:164, append at :698) with qip_storage::ChainArchive is the history record. Raw ticks themselves stay Transient under ADR 0089 (restated in ADR 0100 section 5), so the 'journal holds every tick' half belongs to TICK/FABRIC.

Keep them in the event log and metrics, print a bounded periodic summary or only on state change, and pin it with a test that drives N cycles through node::run and asserts stdout/log output does not grow with N.
